title: A Cellar for the Room
author: P. M. Underhill
blurb: Petra Eastwick, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
